title: heracleum pastinacifolium subsp. incanum
intro: Heracleum pastinacifolium subsp. incanum, commonly known as the Himalayan hogweed, is a plant species that belongs to the carrot family (Apiaceae). It is valued for its medicinal properties and is used to treat various health conditions, including inflammation, fever, and digestive issues, due to its health benefits of reducing inflammation and acting as an antibacterial agent. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and expectorant properties, which help to relieve pain, reduce swelling, and ease congestion. The bioactive constituents of Heracleum pastinacifolium subsp. incanum include furanocoumarins, alkaloids, and other compounds that contribute to its medicinal properties.
